description: This file defines a collection of custom exception classes for a machine learning / language model application, particularly related to error handling with the Litellm framework. It includes detailed error classes for various error scenarios such as authentication, rate limiting, API errors, and guardrails, often extending existing OpenAI exceptions. The file also contains utility exception classes and shared error-handling structures.

classes.name: AuthenticationError
classes.description: Custom exception class extending openai.AuthenticationError, with additional context such as llm_provider, model, response, retries info.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception indicating resource not found, extending openai.NotFoundError.

classes.name: BadRequestError
classes.description: Custom exception for bad requests, extending openai.BadRequestError.

classes.name: ImageFetchError
classes.description: Subclass of BadRequestError specific to image fetch failures.

classes.name: UnprocessableEntityError
classes.description: Exception class for 422 errors from OpenAI, extending openai.UnprocessableEntityError.

classes.name: Timeout
classes.description: Represents timeout errors, extending openai.APITimeoutError with additional info.

classes.name: PermissionDeniedError
classes.description: Access denied errors, extending openai.PermissionDeniedError.

classes.name: RateLimitError
classes.description: Throttling or rate limit errors, extending openai.RateLimitError.

classes.name: ContextWindowExceededError
classes.description: Indicates exceeding context window limits, subclass of BadRequestError.

classes.name: RejectedRequestError
classes.description: Catch-all for proxy guardrail rejection errors, subclass of BadRequestError.

classes.name: ContentPolicyViolationError
classes.description: Trigger for content policy violations, subclass of BadRequestError.

classes.name: ServiceUnavailableError
classes.description: Represents 503 errors, extends openai.APIStatusError.

classes.name: BadGatewayError
classes.description: HTTP 502 errors, extending openai.APIStatusError.

classes.name: APIError
classes.description: General API error for invalid response objects, extending openai.APIError.

classes.name: APIConnectionError
classes.description: Errors related to connection issues, extending openai.APIConnectionError.

classes.name: APIResponseValidationError
classes.description: Errors validating API responses, extending openai.APIResponseValidationError.

classes.name: JSONSchemaValidationError
classes.description: Specific validation error for JSON schema mismatches, subclass of APIResponseValidationError.

classes.name: OpenAIError
classes.description: Generic wrapper for openai errors.

classes.name: UnsupportedParamsError
classes.description: Indicates unsupported parameters error.

classes.name: LiteLLMUnknownProvider
classes.description: Error indicating a missing or unknown LLM provider.

classes.name: GuardrailRaisedException
classes.description: Exception class for guardrail intervention triggers.

classes.name: BlockedPiiEntityError
classes.description: Raised when a guardrail blocks a PII entity.

classes.name: MidStreamFallbackError
classes.description: Error class for fallback during streaming, extending ServiceUnavailableError.

classes.name: GuardrailInterventionNormalStringError
classes.description: Exception used to return normal string responses when a guardrail intervenes.

classes.name: BudgetExceededError
classes.description: Exception indicating cost budget limits exceeded.

methods.name: _transform_error_to_string
methods.description: Transforms content policy violation errors into string messages.
